identity.title: [C-SDLC v2] Restore governed draft-to-ready publication reconciliation

values.task_boundary: Restore governed draft-to-ready and reconcile-ready publication operations in the v2 publication owner, with tests and skill/inventory alignment.
deliverables: Durable exact-identity lifecycle truth after successful remote readback.
csdlc-v2/tests/publication_ready.rs focused tests for success, uncertainty/recovery, identity drift, stale CAS, pre-state rejection, and zero-write failure paths.
Updated publication skill and operator inventory documentation.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Restore a typed exact-identity draft-to-ready operation under the authoritative v2 publication owner.
AC-2: Re-observe exact repository, PR, head SHA, open state, and draft state before and after mutation.
AC-3: Record ready publication truth atomically and provide reconciliation after uncertain remote response.
AC-4: Reject mismatched repository, PR, head, non-draft pre-state, closed state, stale generation, or stale digest without lifecycle mutation.
AC-5: Align publication skill text and installed binary inventory with the implemented command surface.
AC-6: Add focused tests for success, remote uncertainty, recovery, identity drift, and zero-write failure paths.
non_goals: Merge, finish, cleanup, or issue closeout
